title: Go Developer
description: A roadmap for Go backend development: core language, concurrency, APIs, databases, testing, containers, observability, and cloud-ready services.

tree.name: Go Foundations
tree.description: Learn Go syntax, modules, structs, interfaces, errors, packages, tooling, and idiomatic code organization.

resources.title: Learn GO Fast: Full Tutorial (Alex Mux)

children.name: Core Language and Tooling
children.description: Use slices, maps, structs, methods, interfaces, errors, modules, gofmt, go vet, and project layout.

children.name: Concurrency
children.description: Use goroutines, channels, contexts, cancellation, worker pools, mutexes, race detection, and graceful shutdown.

tree.name: Web Services and Databases
tree.description: Build REST APIs, middleware, auth, validation, database access, migrations, and service boundaries.

children.name: HTTP APIs
children.description: Use net/http, routers, middleware, JSON, validation, error responses, pagination, and OpenAPI docs.

children.name: SQL and Persistence
children.description: Use database/sql, pgx, migrations, transactions, query performance, and repository patterns.

children.name: Practice: Concurrent Worker Pool
children.description: Build a worker pool with context cancellation, retries, metrics, tests, and graceful shutdown.

tree.name: Testing, Performance, and Operations
tree.description: Write robust services with tests, benchmarks, profiling, observability, background workers, and deployment discipline.

children.name: Testing and Benchmarks
children.description: Write table-driven tests, mocks, integration tests, benchmarks, fuzz tests, and race-detector checks.

children.name: Observability and Profiling
children.description: Add structured logs, metrics, traces, pprof profiling, health checks, and SLO-style dashboards.

tree.name: Deployment and Portfolio
tree.description: Ship a Go service as a small binary or container with safe config, release automation, and runbooks.

children.name: Deployment Patterns
children.description: Build minimal Docker images, manage config/secrets, add graceful shutdown, migrations, and rollout checks.

children.name: Project: URL Shortener Service
children.description: Build a Go API with PostgreSQL, Redis cache, rate limits, tests, metrics, Docker, and deployment notes.
